comments.body:
***Extra Information***

Rank Tech: 2
Consumed Gauge: 60
Range: 100
Scatter Range: 60

It requires one seconds before the Tech will be used.
With advanture job this Tech will be directly used.

Effect:
Aside from damage, your target(s) get poisoned and loses -20 stamina per second. This effect last for at least 20 seconds. Higher Trap prolongs the poison-effect.

comments.body:
After the release with chapter 3 of Atlantis (Acropolis), the conditions for obtaining this tech is now:

Trap rank 3
Biology rank 3
Bee Call
